class_provenance_warning:
These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 196 abilities,
      164 have had their tooltip read in game, and 27 were looked for and not
      found .
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

Barbwood Talisman I

Also recorded as Barbwood Talisman

Druid · Level 1 · Alteration

Effect

Imbues your defensive target's party with a talisman that increases armor class by 12, hit points by 24 and grants a 2 point damage shield. Does not stack with Talisman of the Grove.

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect
I 1 16 +12 AC, +24 HP, 3 pt damage shield
II 8 38 +36 AC, +72 HP, 10 pt damage shield
III 16 60 +60 AC, +120 HP, 17 pt damage shield
IV 24 Unknown +84 AC, +168 HP, 25 pt damage shield
V 32 Unknown +108 AC, +216 HP, 33 pt damage shield
VI 40 Unknown +132 AC, +264 HP, 42 pt damage shield
VII 48 Unknown +156 AC, +312 HP, 49 pt damage shield

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007-2008

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Not present in the VGO Emulator build as of August 2026 — a player at the level cap went through the whole Druid spellbook and does not have it. Note the shape of what is missing: Barbwood Talisman survives only at rank I while every higher rank is gone, and Barkskin, Moon Talisman and Stormcaller's Fury are absent entirely. That could mean the build has not implemented them yet, or that the live game consolidated these buffs into one. The archive cannot tell which. Kept because this records the game as it shipped, not the emulator; the figures are the wiki's and unverified.
